Pick up an object.desc: This action allows the robot to pick up an object from a surface or stack. For example, the robot picks up a block from the table or from another block.

Put down an object.desc: This action enables the robot to put down an object that it is holding. For example, the robot puts down a block on the table or on top of another block.

Stack an object on top of another.desc: This action enables the robot to place one object on top of another, creating a stack. For example, the robot stacks a yellow block on top of a green block.

Unstack an object from the top of anothe.desc: This action enables the robot to remove an object from the top of a stack. For example, the robot unstacks a yellow block that is on top of a green block.
